title: US announces death of another service member, Jordan summons Iranian envoy over attacks
summary: A US service member died during a "controlled detonation" of unexploded ordnance from a downed Iranian drone in northern Iraq, the military said Sunday. It followed the killing of two US troops in Jordan late Friday.
